confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors rest on several Chania cost-of-living listings from search results (Numbeo, Expatistan, Livingcost, Hikersbay, Mylifeelsewhere). These are crowd-sourced or blog-based, with varying dates. Euro figures were converted at about 1.16 USD per EUR, the rate implied by paired figures in those sources, not separately verified. Cocktail and wine are weaker and rest on Crete bar guides, cross-checked against the beer anchor (cocktail about 2.2 times beer; wine glass about 1.4 times). July peak-season prices may run above these averages. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no accommodation searches or live listings were used.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city proxy used. Food and drink anchors are Chania-specific, with Crete-wide bar and cafe guides for cocktail and wine. Accommodation anchors are model estimates for Chania in July peak season.
